pagina.toast_enviada: Order marked as sent. You can now record the supplier's response.
pagina.erro_enviar: Error marking the order as sent.
pagina.toast_submetido: Order submitted. It now awaits approval and can no longer be edited.
pagina.cancelar_aviso: A cancelled order cannot be reinstated — if you still need to buy, create a new order.

lista.vazio_titulo: There are no purchase orders yet.
lista.vazio_texto: Use the purchase suggestions to see what to replenish, or create an order directly.
lista.acao_enviar: Mark as sent to the supplier
lista.sod_excepcao: Approved by its creator — segregation of duties exception

receb.aviso_validade: This product is expiry-controlled. Without the date there is no way to raise an alert before the loss.
receb.aviso_expirada: The date entered has already passed. If the goods arrived out of date, that is fine — if not, check the year.
receb.erro_linhas: Could not load the order lines.
receb.erro_quantidade: Enter the quantity received for at least one product.
receb.erro_sem_validade: The expiry date is missing for: {{produtos}}. Without it there is no way to raise an alert before the loss.
receb.erro_sem_lote: The batch code is missing for: {{produtos}}.
receb.toast_recebida: Goods received. Stock, average cost and accounts payable have been updated.
receb.sem_armazens: There are no active warehouses. Create one before receiving goods.
receb.documento_ajuda: Invoice or delivery note. Helps with reconciliation later.
receb.ajuste_parcial: Adjust the quantities for a partial receipt
receb.todas_recebidas: All lines of this order have already been received.
receb.excede: You cannot receive more than what is outstanding for "{{produto}}". To receive more, correct the purchase order.
receb.aviso_confirmar: On confirming, the stock of the chosen warehouse is increased, the weighted average cost is recalculated and an account payable to this supplier is created in the finance module.

alterar.erro_ja_na_ordem: "{{nome}}" is already on the order. Adjust the quantity.
alterar.erro_remover_recebida: "{{nome}}" already has goods received — it cannot be removed from the order.
alterar.erro_sem_produtos: The order needs at least one product.
alterar.erro_quantidade: The quantity of "{{nome}}" must be greater than zero.
alterar.erro_abaixo_recebido: "{{nome}}" has already received {{recebido}} — you cannot order less than that.
alterar.erro_motivo: Enter the reason for the change — it is recorded in the version.
alterar.toast_alterada: Order changed. A new version was created.
alterar.aviso_aprovada: This order is already approved. If the change is material, the approval is voided and the order goes back to awaiting a decision.
alterar.pesquisa_placeholder: Click to see the products, or type to search...
alterar.catalogo_vazio: The company has no products in the catalogue yet.
alterar.a_mostrar: Showing {{mostrados}} of {{total}}. Type to find the remaining {{restantes}}.
alterar.motivo_exemplo: E.g. supplier updated the price, customer asked for a larger quantity...

aprov.erro_linhas: Could not load the order lines.
aprov.erro_motivo: A rejection requires a reason — it is what whoever corrects the order will read.
aprov.toast_aprovada: Order approved. It can now be sent and receive goods.
aprov.aviso_auto: You created this order. The approval will go through, but it is recorded as a segregation of duties exception — visible to anyone auditing.
aprov.motivo_exemplo_rejeitar: Price above the contracted one; renegotiate before sending.
aprov.aviso_aprovada: Once approved, the order can no longer be edited. A change creates a new version and, if it touches what is being bought, requires approval again.

avisos.vazio_ajuda: Record what the supplier declares to have shipped from the purchase order, in the Orders tab.
avisos.erro_motivo: Cancelling requires a reason — it frees up the order balance.
avisos.toast_cancelado: Notice cancelled. The balance returns to the purchase order.
avisos.erro_recebido_por: Enter who received the load — proof without a name proves nothing.
avisos.toast_entrega: Proof of delivery recorded. Stock does not change — that is the goods receipt.
avisos.nota_lote: Batch and expiry as declared by the supplier. What enters stock is decided at goods receipt.
avisos.prova_ajuda_3: — whoever signs at the door has only signed that a lorry pulled up.
avisos.cancelar_ajuda: Cancelling frees up the balance of this declaration, and the order can again receive notices for the same quantities. Without a written reason, nobody understands months later why the goods never came.

conf.toast_com_falta_zero: Response recorded. {{count}} units remain unconfirmed — decide whether to buy from another supplier.
conf.toast_com_falta_one: Response recorded. {{count}} unit remains unconfirmed — decide whether to buy from another supplier.
conf.toast_com_falta_other: Response recorded. {{count}} units remain unconfirmed — decide whether to buy from another supplier.
conf.por_confirmar_ajuda: They do not disappear — they stay flagged on the order so you can decide whether to buy from another supplier or accept less. Knowing this today beats finding out on delivery day.
conf.observacoes_exemplo: Only 300 in the warehouse; the rest arrives next week.

aviso.erro_sem_linhas: Declare at least one line with a quantity.
aviso.toast_com_falta_zero: Notice recorded. {{count}} units remain to be notified on this order.
aviso.toast_com_falta_one: Notice recorded. {{count}} unit remains to be notified on this order.
aviso.toast_com_falta_other: Notice recorded. {{count}} units remain to be notified on this order.
aviso.toast_completo: Notice recorded. The order is now fully declared.
aviso.nota_lote: The batch is what the supplier declares. What enters stock is decided at goods receipt, after looking at the box.
aviso.guia_ajuda: Unique per supplier — the same note twice would consume the balance twice.

pedido.erro_ja_no_pedido: "{{nome}}" is already on the order. Adjust the quantity.
pedido.erro_quantidade: The quantity of "{{nome}}" must be greater than zero.
pedido.toast_criado: Purchase order created as a draft.
pedido.subtitulo: It stays as a draft — it is not sent to the supplier and does not affect stock.
pedido.sem_data: Without this date the supplier's punctuality cannot be measured.
pedido.pesquisa_placeholder: Click to see the products, or type to search...
pedido.catalogo_vazio: The company has no products in the catalogue yet.
pedido.a_mostrar: Showing {{mostrados}} of {{total}}. Type to find the remaining {{restantes}}.
pedido.nenhum_no_pedido: No products on the order. Click the field above to see the catalogue.

rec.toast_anulada: Goods receipt voided. The stock has been returned.
rec.vazio: This order has had no goods receipt yet.
rec.aviso_anular: The received stock leaves the warehouse, the average cost is reverted and the account payable to the supplier is cancelled. The order reopens so it can be received again.
rec.motivo_ajuda: It is kept in the record and in the stock movement.

sugestoes.explicacao_RUPTURA: No stock — sales are being lost right now.
sugestoes.explicacao_ABAIXO_MINIMO: Below the reorder point set for the warehouse.
sugestoes.explicacao_VELOCIDADE: At the current rate of sale, the stock will not last until the end of the cover period.
sugestoes.a_analisar: Analysing sales and stock on hand...
sugestoes.nada_a_repor_ajuda: No product is out of stock, below minimum, or running out within the {{dias}} days of cover.
sugestoes.associe_fornecedor: Link a supplier to this product
sugestoes.a_analisar_n: Analysing {{n}} of the {{total}} lines to replenish.
sugestoes.fornecedores_diferentes: The selected lines are from different suppliers. A purchase order is to a single supplier — select the lines of one of them, or change the supplier on the order.
sugestoes.subtitulo: Combines each warehouse's reorder point with the rate of sale.

versoes.vazio: This order has not been changed yet — there is only the original version.
versoes.material: Material change — it voided the approval in force at the time.
